topic: ripen green tomatoes picked before frost
core_question: How do I ripen tomatoes I picked while they were still green? (secondary: How do you break in a new pair of hiking boots so they don't cause blisters on a long hike?)
answer_summary: Place the green tomatoes in a closed paper bag with a ripe banana or apple; the ethylene gas it releases speeds ripening.; after the topic shift: Wear the new boots around the house and on progressively longer short walks before the trip to soften them and identify pressure points, applying moleskin or blister tape to any hot spots.
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there
